rationale: The frontend client perfectly interprets the active generation status of incoming historical messages on page refresh. When the assistant's turn has no response_time metadata, it indicates an in-progress operation, triggering Valtio-driven reactive states to render the ThinkingLoader. No UI regressions, fully compliant with EPAM strict React/TS standards.
